text:
tariq: small docs drift I want to fix: README examples still reference v1/generate but our API root switched to /v1. the example uses /generate (which still proxies) but we should update to /v1/generate everywhere. Also one embed snippet uses 'model: "redwood-7b"' but should be 'model: "redwood-7b-instruct"' in our curated list.

emma: good catch. Any customer impact?

tariq: low, but confusing if people pick incompatible model variant names when configuring Dedicated. Also spotted that the Go sample uses `http.NewRequest("POST", url, bytes.NewBufferString(body))` without setting Content-Type. Minor but annoying.

doc-bot: reminder: update changelog and add quick unit test to ensure code fences include language tags.

emma: I'll open a PR with 3 tiny fixes: API path normalization, model name correction in embeds sample, and Go request Content-Type fix. I'll also add a note in the README about model naming nuances between hosted and Dedicated.

tariq: thanks!
